title: K-1 Grand Prix: Fighting Illusion Shou
native_title: Ｋ－１ ファイティング イリュージョン 翔
overview:
The K-1 all-stars gather here!!

The King of Kings

Step into the K-1 ring in this kickboxing game featuring twelve real fighters, including Andy Hug, Peter Aerts, Ernesto Hoost, Sam Greco, Jerome Le Banner, Mike Bernardo, Musashi and Nobuaki Kakuda. Trade punches and kicks in a packed arena and fight to become the king of kings.

Take on computer opponents alone or face a friend head to head. Other modes include a tournament for up to eight players, 3-on-3 team battles and an AI Fighter mode where you tune a fighter's stats and moves.

K-1のオールスターここに集結！！

THE KING OF KINGS
